request: Analyze GSE254368 for PMID 38377006 (Acute Resistance Exercise Modifies Extracellular Vesicle miRNAs Targeting Anabolic Gene Pathways: A Prospective Cohort Study.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: small RNA-seq (TruSeq Small RNA) of plasma extracellular-vesicle RNA, STAR to miRBase v22 / Ensembl 101
final.sample_inclusion: 10 participants (5 men, 5 women), plasma EVs pre and immediately post AHRET; 20 libraries
final.primary_estimand: within-subject change in plasma EV small-RNA (miRNA) abundance, post- vs pre-acute heavy resistance exercise test (6x10 back squat at 75% 1RM)
planned_contrasts: time post vs pre (Abstract RESULTS; paper: 34 miRNAs altered, P < 0.05)
final.paper_method: edgeR workflow (GEO data_processing); deposited DE table has limma topTable columns (logFC, CI.L/R, t, B, adj.P.Val), consistent with edgeR-normalised voom/limma; pairing not stated in abstract

paper_threshold.source_locator: Abstract RESULTS: '34 miRNAs were altered by AHRET (P < 0.05)'

final.paper_results: 34 DE miRNAs at P<0.05 -> IPA, 175 canonical pathways (P<0.01); deposited table: 46 features at P.Value<0.05 of 642 tested, 34 of them miRNA biotype, adj.P.Val all >= 0.05

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Only the PubMed abstract and GEO series description are available (no full text). Abstract METHODS/RESULTS give 10 participants, pre/post AHRET, DE miRNAs at P<0.05 (raw P; no FDR, no fold-change rule). GEO overall_design: 'Repeated measures study, pre- and immediate-post'. GEO data_processing: edgeR workflow.
paper_reconstruction.locator: PubMed abstract; GEO Series_summary / overall_design / data_processing

checks: 20 GSMs = 10 participants x pre/post, 5 male + 5 female matches abstract
matrix column names equal metadata description for all 20 samples

ownership.reasoning: GSE254368 is the paper's own deposit; miRNA count matrix is the input to the deposited DE table (same sample columns).

candidates.reason_rejected: gene-level counts of all biotypes; paper analyses miRNAs, and the deposited DE table derives from the miRNA count file
transcript level, contains negative values; not the paper's input
author result table, used only for comparison

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns 'sample.bnNN_<sex><id>_<pre|pwo>' equal metadata 'description' exactly; the pattern drops the numeric annotation column transcript_count. Subject = m1/m12/.../f35 token (each appears once pre, once pwo); time from suffix (pwo = post-workout), consistent with characteristics 'time point'.

matrix.reasoning: All values non-negative integers; GEO data_processing: STAR alignment then edgeR workflow and 'raw counts for each sample'. Paper input is raw counts to edgeR. Library sizes vary 0.12M-15.6M (one large library), handled by size-factor normalisation.

design.subject: subject
design.reasoning: Abstract: DE miRNAs between pre- and post-AHRET EVs; GEO: repeated measures. Single within-subject contrast post vs pre. Sex is constant within subject and absorbed by subject blocking; per-sex analyses (5 pairs each) are exploratory.

candidates.reason_rejected: same split as time point, redundant

covariates.name: sex
covariates.disposition: absorbed by subject (between-subject, constant within pair)

covariance.reasoning: Each participant contributes pre and post; subject is the blocking unit (GEO overall_design: repeated measures). Sex is nested in subject, not added separately.

paper_route.method: edgeR workflow / limma topTable (likely voom), pairing unknown
paper_route.reason: Repository edgeR and limma-voom executors take a single design column (no subject blocking), and the abstract does not state the exact model or low-count filter; the paired model is run with DESeq2 and an unpaired limma-voom run is kept as sensitivity.

deviations: DESeq2 paired model instead of edgeR/limma workflow
low-count filter approximating edgeR filterByExpr (CPM >= 20, ~10 reads at median library size 0.48M, in >= 10 samples); authors' filter unknown (they tested 642 features)
all small-RNA biotypes kept in the model as in the deposited table; miRNA-only counts reported separately

method.reasoning: Raw counts support DESeq2; paired design needs subject blocking which only the DESeq2 executor offers among count routes.

threshold.reasoning: Abstract RESULTS: 'P < 0.05' (raw p, no FC). Audit FDR < 0.05 labelled separately.

caveats: Paper comparison rests on the abstract and GEO description only (no full text).
Paper counts 34 miRNAs; our tables count all small-RNA features passing the filter, miRNA-only count reported in HANDBACK.
Raw P < 0.05 with no multiple-testing control; the deposited author table has no feature at adj.P < 0.05.

study.reasoning: Named miRNAs are from the deposited author DE table (P.Value < 0.05), not the abstract.

discrepancies.paper: 34 miRNAs counted; deposited table tested 642 small-RNA features
